dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Are you... Ah, you are the Traveler from afar. I almost mistook you for my brother's messenger, what with you "looking for me" and all.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: So, what business do you have with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your brother?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Yes, Masahito is my elder brother. He is in charge of military affairs in Kannazuka. I'm in charge of government business here in Inazuma City.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: While I was at work, I have been thinking about some issues with our recent policies. However, I can't really tell some of these thoughts to my father, the head of the Kujou Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: When my brother was around before, I could still discuss such matters with him. Now that he is stranded on another island, I guess I can only stew in my own doubt...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Inazuma's policies...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: I am a member of the Kujou Clan and one of the officials of the Tenryou Commission. It's obvious that I should wholeheartedly support the decision of our Almighty Shogun, but...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: I've seen the difficult lives led by our people nowadays from the reports I've received recently. The Sakoku Decree and Vision Hunt Decree... are they really beneficial to our future?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: If the people aren't living happy lives, what's the point of living in an eternal state?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Perhaps I'm just overthinking and worrying too much...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Until next time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Miss Chisato...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, we can finally write to each other now. I really appreciate your help.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Hmm... I don't know if she likes the snacks I made for her... If possible, I'd really like to meet her myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: There are still so many things left for me to do. For our clan... and my own future.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler, it's you.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: I remember how you showed up together with Her Excellency to save me from my predicament, and gave me a chance to stand up on my clan's behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: You have my thanks on that account.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the situation in the Kujou Clan?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Things are quite unstable. I've been made Provisional Clan Head, and I'm working to stem the tide of chaos. Still, it all feels like too much for someone like me at times.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: But since the Almighty Shogun has recognized my will, I cannot disappoint her. I will shoulder our clan's burden.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Even though our paths did diverge previously, I believe that neither my father nor my brother would be content to have our clan remain in this state.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How is your father doing?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: To be honest, I still don't quite understand what my father was thinking, nor did I ever feel that what he did was right.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Father... seems to have taken the conclusion of the previous incident very hard. It seems like he aged several decades overnight — you can barely see any of the conviction and glory he had while leading the clan now.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: But things are different now. Perhaps it's time for the young, like us, to mend the mistakes of our forebears and open a new path for the clan.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's your older brother?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: By tradition, the position of heir should belong to my brother, Masahito.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: I recently exchanged letters with my brother, who is currently at his military post in Kannazuka. I thought he might be angered that I took the post of my own accord... but as it turned out, he was very supportive of me.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: He even said that I was more suited to managing the clan, and that he would support me in his role as a warrior in the Shogun's army.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: With his support, I have more faith that we will be able to start over. This will be a difficult road, but I believe that I can help turn things around.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Miss Chisato...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, we can finally write to each other now. I really appreciate your help.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Hmm... I don't know if she likes the snacks I made for her... If possible, I'd really like to meet her myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: There are still so many things left for me to do. For our clan... and my own future.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Yes, see you again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Miss Chisato...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Thank you so much for your help. This should have been a private matter, but I guess we ended up needing your help on multiple occasions.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Seeing her be so strong fills me with joy. I wish I could give her more support, but I don't want to sway her independent judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: As such, I've decided to give her some space and wait for her from a distance. Given her talents, I'm sure she'll do even better than me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope all goes well with you.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Thank you for your blessing. To be honest, I've learned much from you as well.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: This is just a small gift from me. Please, do accept it.
